messages.subject: Error in 1:dims[1] : argument of length 0
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to the nimble world and am building a multi-method occupancy model to estimate method-specific detection probabilities for three different survey methods. My model will run without covariates, but I get the following error when I add a detection covariate to one method:

Error in 1:dims[1] : argument of length 0

In addition: Warning messages:

1: In min(x, na.rm = na.rm) :

  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf

2: In max(x, na.rm = na.rm) :

  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

3: In min(x, na.rm = na.rm) :

  no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf

4: In max(x, na.rm = na.rm) :

  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf

Timing stopped at: 0.97 0 1.18


I've searched the forum for this error and have not found a solution. I'm fairly sure my indexing is correct and there are no null values in my data that could cause it, so I'm at a bit of a loss. I've attached a reproducible example for diagnosis. I appreciate any help with this!

Best,

Derek

messages.author: 27debeac26f66a0b
messages.subject: RE: Error in 1:dims[1] : argument of length 0
parts:
Dear Derek,

 

You use in priors:

 

pS ~ dbeta(1,1)

 

But you define pS as a matrix in:

 

logit(pS[i,j]) <- a0 + aTime * timeS[i,j]  

 

You can easily solve this problem (eg. deleting the prior)

 

Best regards,

José
